items.description:
# Security Engineer

**Sen Works Viet Nam Co., Ltd.**

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Job Title** | Security Engineer |
| **Department** | IT Services – Information Security |
| **Reports To** | Head of Information Security / Client Security Lead [to be confirmed] |
| **Employment Type** | Full-time labour contract with Sen Works Viet Nam Co., Ltd.; probation of up to 60 days |
| **Work Location** | Vietnam – fully remote |
| **Salary Range** | Up to USD3200 gross/month |

📩 **Apply:** send your CV to [jobs@senworks.com](mailto:jobs@senworks.com)

---

## About Sen Works Viet Nam

Sen Works Viet Nam Co., Ltd. is a Vietnam-based technology and healthcare operations company delivering software development, IT services and revenue cycle management support to healthcare organisations in the United States and Europe. Our people work as dedicated, long-term members of our clients' teams, operating within each client's environment, tools and security standards.

## Role Summary

In this role you will be dedicated to a US healthcare services client that operates a growing network of affiliated medical practices. You will work inside the client's Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment and collaborate daily with the client's US-based teams on systems that store, process or transmit protected health information (PHI).

The Security Engineer is the primary architect and engineer of preventive and detective security controls across the client's endpoint, identity, network, cloud and application layers. You will lead the design, implementation and continuous improvement of the security control environment, run vulnerability management, and build the technical evidence that keeps the client audit-ready.

## Key Responsibilities

### Security Architecture & Engineering

- Design, deploy and manage core security platforms: EDR, email security, identity protection, privileged access management, network security and data loss prevention.
- Advance zero trust across identity, device, network and application layers, strengthening conditional access, MFA and least privilege.
- Improve Azure and Microsoft 365 security posture through configuration baselines, policy as code and continuous posture management.
- Set security standards, hardening baselines and reference architectures; run security design reviews for new systems, integrations, vendors and changes.

### Vulnerability & Threat Management

- Lead the vulnerability management program: scanning coverage, risk-based prioritisation, remediation tracking and exception governance.
- Align patching, configuration and end-of-life remediation with security priorities and clinical uptime requirements.
- Direct penetration tests, red team engagements and attack surface management, and validate remediation.
- Use threat intelligence and healthcare-sector attack trends to refine control priorities.

### Compliance Engineering & Detection Enablement

- Build technical controls and evidence supporting HIPAA Security Rule, HITRUST, SOC 2 and client security requirements.
- Strengthen SOC detection by engineering log sources, telemetry pipelines and automated response integrations.
- Define measures for control coverage, vulnerability remediation and platform health; report control gaps, risk posture and investment priorities to leadership.
- Manage security vendors, MSPs and consultants.

### Education & Certifications

- Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field; an equivalent combination of education, certifications and experience will be considered.
- **CISSP, CCSP** or equivalent advanced security certification required; Microsoft SC-100 or AZ-500 preferred.

### Experience

- 7+ years of information security experience, including at least 3 years in security engineering or architecture.
- Experience designing and operating enterprise security platforms across endpoint, identity, email, network and cloud.
- Proven success measurably reducing risk, e.g. remediation rates, MFA and EDR coverage, or reduced privileged access.
- Experience supporting HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2 or ISO 27001 assessments with technical evidence and remediation.
- Healthcare, healthcare technology or managed services experience is a strong advantage.

### Knowledge & Skills

- Security controls in Azure, Microsoft 365 and hybrid Active Directory environments.
- NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, CIS Controls and zero trust principles.
- IAM, PKI, network segmentation, encryption and secure configuration management.
- EDR, SIEM, SOAR, PAM, DLP, email security, vulnerability scanning and CSPM platforms.
- PowerShell, Python and infrastructure as code for automation and evidence collection.
- HIPAA Security Rule and HITRUST CSF control mapping (training provided).
- Professional English (spoken and written) for daily work with US-based colleagues and clients.

### Personal Abilities

- Design controls that reduce risk without impeding clinical workflows.
- Translate emerging threats into practical control improvements and lead implementations through to handoff.
- Present risk and architecture decisions clearly in English to executive and clinical leadership.

## Working Conditions

- Flexible working hours, with an agreed daily overlap window with US-based teams for meetings and real-time collaboration; participation in a shared on-call escalation rotation for security incidents.
- A dedicated, private workspace with stable high-speed internet suitable for handling confidential information and PHI.
- Fully remote from Vietnam.
- Prolonged computer use and extended phone and video communication; sustained concentration during incidents, maintenance windows and time-sensitive work.

## What We Offer

- 💰 Salary reviewed annually.
- 🏠 Flexible working hours and fully remote work.
- 🎁 13th-month salary and performance bonus.
- 🌙 Night-shift allowance in accordance with the Vietnam Labour Code for any additional hours worked at night.
- 🏥 Full social, health and unemployment insurance in accordance with Vietnamese law, plus private healthcare insurance.
- 📚 Company-sponsored certifications and training budget.
- 💻 Company-managed laptop and equipment.
- 🌴 Annual leave of at least 12 days plus Vietnamese public holidays.
- 🌍 Long-term work with international teams on US healthcare technology.

---

# Cloud Engineer (Azure Platform / IaC)

**Sen Works Viet Nam Co., Ltd.**

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Job Title** | Cloud Engineer (Azure Platform / IaC) |
| **Department** | IT Services – Infrastructure & Cloud |
| **Reports To** | Head of Infrastructure / Client Technical Lead [to be confirmed] |
| **Employment Type** | Full-time labour contract with Sen Works Viet Nam Co., Ltd.; probation of up to 60 days |
| **Work Location** | Vietnam – fully remote |
| **Salary Range** | Up to USD3000 gross |

📩 **Apply:** send your CV to [jobs@senworks.com](mailto:jobs@senworks.com)

---

## Role Summary

In this role you will be dedicated to a US healthcare services client that operates a growing network of affiliated medical practices. You will work inside the client's Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365 environment and collaborate daily with the client's US-based teams on systems that store, process or transmit protected health information (PHI).

The Cloud Engineer is the principal designer and builder of the client's cloud platform. You will lead cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, platform automation and cloud operations, building the landing zones, guardrails and delivery pipelines that give product, data and integration teams a secure, compliant, cost-effective foundation for PHI workloads.

## Key Responsibilities

### Cloud Architecture & Platform Engineering

- Design and implement Azure architecture: landing zones, subscription and tenant structure, identity integration, networking, governance and the platform foundation for Azure Virtual Desktop.
- Deliver the platform through infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep), policy as code and CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure changes.
- Set reference architectures, naming and tagging standards and environment patterns.
- Lead migration of on-premises and practice-site workloads to Azure, including dependency mapping, cutover planning and decommissioning.

### Cloud Operations, Reliability & Cost

- Lead observability, monitoring, alerting and incident response for cloud platforms; drive root cause analysis and reliability improvements.
- Align configuration, identity, encryption, key management and logging with HIPAA, HITRUST and SOC 2 in partnership with Information Security.
- Design and test backup, DR and business continuity to meet defined RTO and RPO.
- Use cost and utilisation data to right-size resources and apply reservations and savings plans.

### Enablement & Integration

- Build reusable modules, pipelines and documentation so teams can deploy compliant workloads without bespoke engineering.
- Design secure connectivity and data exchange between cloud, on-premises systems, practice sites and third-party healthcare platforms.
- Conduct design and code reviews; define measures for availability, deployment frequency, change success rate and cost efficiency, and report to leadership.

## Qualifications

### Education & Certifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field; an equivalent combination of education, certifications and experience will be considered.
- **Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)** or equivalent expert-level cloud certification required; DevOps, security or networking certifications preferred.

### Experience

- 5+ years of infrastructure or platform engineering experience, including at least 4 years designing and operating production workloads in Azure or a comparable public cloud.
- Experience leading cloud migrations and greenfield builds, including landing zone design, networking and identity integration.
- Proven success improving reliability, deployment velocity and cloud cost efficiency through automation.
- Experience building cloud environments that meet HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2 or ISO 27001 requirements.
- Healthcare, healthcare technology or managed services experience is a strong advantage.

### Knowledge & Skills

- Terraform or Bicep with Git-based workflows; Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
- Azure networking and security: VNets, private endpoints, ExpressRoute/VPN, RBAC, Azure Policy, Key Vault, Defender for Cloud and Entra ID.
- Azure Well-Architected Framework and Cloud Adoption Framework.
- Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, AKS), serverless patterns and SRE practices.
- PowerShell, Python or Bash; Azure Monitor and Log Analytics; cloud cost management.
- HIPAA, the shared responsibility model and BAAs with cloud providers (training provided).
- Professional English (spoken and written) for daily work with US-based colleagues and clients.

## Working Conditions

- Flexible working hours, with an agreed daily overlap window with US-based teams for meetings and real-time collaboration.
- Fully remote from Vietnam; no business travel or on-site attendance is required.

## What We Offer

- 💰 Salary reviewed annually.
- 🏠 Flexible working hours and fully remote work – no travel or on-site attendance required.
- 🎁 13th-month salary and performance bonus.
- 🌙 Night-shift allowance in accordance with the Vietnam Labour Code for any hours worked at night.
- 🏥 Full social, health and unemployment insurance in accordance with Vietnamese law, plus private healthcare insurance.
- 📚 Company-sponsored certifications and training budget.
- 💻 Company-managed laptop and equipment.
- 🌴 Annual leave of at least 12 days plus Vietnamese public holidays.
- 🌍 Long-term work with international teams.

---

## How to Apply

Send your CV to **[jobs@senworks.com](mailto:jobs@senworks.com)** with the subject line: `Cloud Engineer (Azure Platform / IaC) – [Your Name]`

This role is ideal for an experienced engineer who can independently deliver high-quality solutions, contribute to technical discussions, work effectively with international clients, and support successful project delivery in an outsourcing environment.
The ideal candidate should have solid hands-on experience in Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript, with the ability to work across backend and frontend systems at Senior level.
**I. REQUIREMENTS**
• 5+ years of professional software development experience, including experience working at Senior Developer level
• Strong hands-on experience with Python and solid experience with JavaScript and TypeScript
• Strong experience in backend development and practical experience with modern frontend development
• Good understanding of software architecture, system design, object-oriented design, and scalable application development
• Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, or Vue
• Experience designing, developing, and integrating RESTful APIs
• Working knowledge of relational or NoSQL databases, automated
testing, Git, and code review practices
• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills; able to
work independently on complex tasks
• Good English communication skills, able to discuss requirements
and technical solutions with international customers
• Strong teamwork, ownership, and time-management skills in Agile
delivery environments
   
• Experience working in outsourcing or multi-project environments is preferred
**Nice to Have:**
• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
• Experience with DevOps and CI/CD practices
• Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized environments
• Experience with microservices architecture
• Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform
• Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g.,
Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, etc.)
• Experience working with high-scale or enterprise systems
• Ability to support pre-sales activities or technical proposal
discussions with customers
**II. BENEFITS & PERKS** 
1. Working Hours
• Check-in at 8:30 AM; no check-out required
• Working days: Monday to Friday; weekends (Saturday & Sunday) off
2. Exclusive Leave Policy
• 12 annual leave days per year; public holidays in accordance with Vietnamese labor law
• 01 additional company holiday (the second Monday of October every year)
3. Transparent Salary & Bonus Scheme
• Bonuses on company anniversary and Lunar New Year (Tet)
• Year-end performance bonus based on business results
4. Engaging & Collaborative Work Environment                          
 • Participation in major annual events: Year End Party, company summer trip, and celebrations such as International Women’s Day (March 8), International Men’s Day (November 19), etc.
• Exciting sports activities: Sports Day, E-sports tournaments, etc.
• Active internal clubs: Yoga Club, Football Club, etc.
• Modern open workspace with well-equipped facilities: Tatami
Room, Mother Room, Pantry, etc.

• A wide range of free training programs covering both technical and soft skills
• Free in-depth offline Japanese language courses from N5 to N1, including direct conversation (kaiwa) with native Japanese teachers
• Free access to the Udemy online learning platform
• Financial support for exam preparation and certification, with
additional rewards for achieving advanced certifications
• Opportunities to become an internal trainer, with compensation
provided
• Participation in workshops, seminars, and networking opportunities
with leading experts in various fields
• Company Address: 4th Floor, Hoa Binh Building, 106 Hoang Quoc Viet Street, Hanoi, Vietnam

items.title: [Hiring] Senior Solidity Smart Contract Engineer | Remote | $12K–$15K/month
items.description:
## Company/Team Overview

**BitAngels** is a US-based blockchain investment group with a long-standing focus on Web3, blockchain infrastructure, and decentralized projects.

We are currently supporting an **Ethereum**-based decentralized governance and staking project and are seeking a Senior Solidity Engineer to join the core protocol development team.

The project already has an MVP and is entering the next phase of product and protocol development. We are looking for an engineer with hands-on production experience who can contribute to technical solutions and architectural decision-making.

**Company Website:** https://bitangels.us/
**Contact Email:** dylan.reed@bitangels.us

## Compensation & Benefits

* **$12,000–$15,000 USD / month**
* Full-time or Part-time options available
* Remote work
* Work directly with the project and engineering teams
* Participate in core protocol design and technical decision-making

## Location

* **Work Location:** Remote; candidates from Mainland China and Hong Kong are welcome
* **Contact Information:**

* Hiring Manager: Dylan Reed
* Email: dylan.reed@bitangels.us
* Telegram: @Web3HiringTalents

## Job Details

* **Employment Type:** Full-time or Part-time
* **Remote Work:** Yes
* **Time Zone Requirement:** Primarily GMT+8; must cover core working hours and adapt to collaboration within a distributed international team
* **Communication Language:** English is the primary language for daily communication (basic professional English proficiency required); technical discussions can be supplemented with written communication. ## Role Requirements & Responsibilities

### Key Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain Ethereum/EVM smart contracts using Solidity
* Lead the development of core protocol features such as Staking and Governance
* Participate in smart contract architecture and technical design
* Conduct code reviews, security audits, and gas optimization
* Write tests and assist with smart contract deployment
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to drive protocol development and iteration

### Requirements

* Solid experience in Solidity and Ethereum/EVM development
* Proven experience developing and deploying smart contracts in production environments
* Familiarity with DeFi, Staking, Governance, and Token mechanisms
* Understanding of common smart contract security vulnerabilities
* Proficiency with development and testing tools such as Foundry and Hardhat
* Ability to independently own core modules and participate in technical decision-making
* Strong English technical communication skills

**Experience with DAO, Governance, or Staking protocol development, or smart contract security/auditing, is a plus.**

## Work Environment

We are an international, remote-first Web3 team with members distributed across various regions.

This role goes beyond simply building to pre-defined specifications. We look for engineers who can actively participate in protocol design, technical discussions, and early-stage product decision-making, while taking ownership of core smart contracts.

If you are interested in this opportunity, please contact us directly:

**Hiring Manager: Dylan Reed**
**Email: dylan.reed@bitangels.us**
**Telegram: @Web3HiringTalents**

Please include the following when applying:

* CV / Resume
* GitHub profile or relevant projects
* Solidity / Web3 development experience
* Current availability (Full-time / Part-time)

We will first review your background and experience. If there is a preliminary match, we will provide more details about the project and technical direction, and schedule an online call to discuss the role and get to know each other better.
Send feedback

items.title: Australian marketplace startup - Senior Software Engineer (React / Full-Stack) - Remote/Vietnam - FT
items.description:
## Location

* Remote / Vietnam (distributed team across Australia and Vietnam)

## Salary Expectation

* Competitive (negotiable based on experience)

## Requirements

* 5+ years of professional software development experience
* Experience designing and building full-stack features end-to-end (UI through backend integration)
* Backend development and API design (REST/gRPC)
* Relational databases and data modelling
* Cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and containerisation
* CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices
* Strong written/spoken English for distributed, async-first collaboration

## Skills

### Must Have

* React Strength track: React, TypeScript, modern build tools (Webpack, Babel), state management (TanStack or similar)
* Full-Stack Generalist track: React / React Native plus work across Rails, Kotlin, and Golang services
* Comfort working across multiple programming languages and stacks
* Writing comprehensive tests within strong CI/CD practices
* Applying AI tooling effectively in day-to-day engineering

### Ideally

* User analytics and data transformation pipelines
* Prior work in marketplace / consumer product environments
* Experience migrating legacy systems to modern architecture patterns

### Responsibilities

Own full-stack product features on the Product Engineering team across two related senior tracks (React Strength and Full-Stack Generalist).

### You’ll be responsible for

* Designing and building full-stack features across the React/TypeScript (and React Native) frontend and Kotlin / Go / Rails backends
* Implementing robust API integrations following BFF (Backend for Frontend) patterns
* Building responsive, accessible user interfaces using the design system
* Writing tests and contributing to CI/CD, observability, monitoring, and on-call
* Mentoring teammates and raising engineering standards
* Judging when a complex solution is warranted vs when a simpler one ships reliably

### You can bring

* Strong product thinking and attention to craft
* Ownership and autonomy in a distributed, async-first environment
* A consistent focus on user experience and technical quality

### Why it would be awesome to work with us

* Own features end-to-end on a real marketplace product, not slice-only tickets
* Modern frontend plus a multi-language microservices ecosystem (Golang, Rails, Kotlin)
* Distributed team across Australia, Portugal, and Vietnam
* Culture that prefers the simplest solution that gets the job done

### What's the roadmap is like for the near future.
* Ongoing migration from legacy systems to modern architecture patterns. Heavily AI-assisted SLDC (Claude account provided)
* BFF-based API integration across a multi-language backend
* Design-system-driven UI shared across web (and mobile for the Generalist track)

### Contact
SMS / WhatsApp: 0583362116

- Practical experience building GenAI/LLM systems beyond basic chatbots.
- Experience with Agentic AI concepts including tool/function calling, state, memory, planning, and execution loops.
- Experience with RAG, embeddings, and vector databases.
- Experience deploying and operating AI/ML or LLM solutions in production.
